# Vendored browser libraries

- `qr-code-styling.js`: qr-code-styling 1.9.2 browser bundle (MIT). The bundled `qrcode-generator` byte encoder is configured to use its included UTF-8 encoder by default so Chinese text and Emoji round-trip correctly.
- `jsQR.js`: jsQR 1.4.0 browser bundle (Apache-2.0).

The upstream license texts are stored alongside the scripts. These files are kept local so `index.html` works without a network connection.
